basis.governing_question: Why did prepaid churn rise in 2025, and how can Lusitania Telecom bring it down?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish why prepaid churn rose in 2025 and define the retention initiatives to roll out.

gate.label: Go/no-go on rollout
gate.decision: Proceed to rollout with the prioritized retention initiatives?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Roll out the retention program with Lusitania Telecom's teams and track its effect on prepaid churn.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Do the first results support continuing the retention program?

workstreams.name: Customer analytics
workstreams.answers: Which prepaid customers left in 2025, and what explains the rise in churn?
activities: Analyze prepaid churn by segment from operational data
Compare 2025 prepaid churn with earlier years
Interview customers who left to test the data findings

workstreams.name: Store operations
workstreams.answers: How do store processes and staff handle prepaid customers who may leave, and where do they fall short?
activities: Interview store staff about prepaid customer interactions
Review store process documents and performance data

workstreams.name: Retention offers
workstreams.answers: Which current retention offers work for prepaid customers, and what should the new program contain?
activities: Review current retention offers and their take-up data
Define options for the new retention program
Prioritize initiatives against churn and store findings

workstreams.name: Retention offers
workstreams.answers: How are the chosen retention offers launched to prepaid customers, and are they ready to go live?
activities: Prepare the chosen retention offers for launch
Launch the offers to prepaid customers in waves
Adjust offer terms based on early customer response

workstreams.name: Store operations
workstreams.answers: How do stores take up the new retention procedures, and what do staff need to apply them?
activities: Brief store staff on the retention offers and procedures
Introduce changed store procedures for prepaid customers
Collect feedback from store staff on customer reactions

workstreams.name: Customer analytics
workstreams.answers: Is prepaid churn falling where the retention offers and store changes are live?
activities: Set up churn tracking against the baseline
Compare churn of customers with and without the offers
Report results to the steering group

deliverables.name: Prepaid churn drivers by customer segment
Findings on store handling of at-risk prepaid customers
Assessment of current prepaid retention offers
Offer rollout plan with readiness checks
Retention offers live for prepaid customers
Store staff briefing on the retention program
Store procedures for prepaid retention in use
Results report with next steps for the retention program

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, plan and data access
events.decision: Is the scope of the three workstreams confirmed?
agenda: Present the plan of work, workstreams and steering meetings
Align on data access and client contacts for each workstream
Confirm the scope of the three workstreams

events.label: Check-in: early findings
events.purpose: Review early churn and offer findings
events.decision: Do the early findings change where the team should look next?
agenda: Present early churn drivers by customer segment
Review the assessment of current retention offers
Discuss what to examine before the gate

events.label: Go/no-go on rollout
events.purpose: Decide whether to roll out the program
events.decision: Proceed to rollout with the prioritized retention initiatives?
agenda: Present churn drivers, offer assessment and store findings
Review the prioritized retention initiatives for rollout
Decide whether to proceed to rollout

events.label: Rollout readiness workshop
events.purpose: Review readiness before anything goes live
events.decision: Is the program ready to go live in stores and with customers?
agenda: Review the offer rollout plan and readiness checks
Review store staff readiness and the churn tracker

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Review first results of the rollout
events.decision: Do the first results support continuing the retention program?
agenda: Present results from the live offers and store changes
Decide whether to continue the retention program

architect_notes: The 5-week Diagnostic and 8-week Implementation split is an estimate; the brief gives only three months (13 weeks) in total and no stage lengths.
